title: The End and To Be Continued
paragraphs: About three days later, Filo-tan and Father returned to the village. It had been really tough searching for them over those three days. I, for one, had thought it would be easier to find them, but their ability to make a clean getaway was far beyond what I’d imagined.

They were already impressive in the first world, but with their stats, skills, and Magic all enhanced, their ability to escape had improved dramatically. I tracked them down by relying on my years of experience, deducing the locations of the portals that Father possessed, and following their scent.

However, finding them wasn’t the end of it. With Father-in-law’s leadership and Skills, Filo-chan’s speed, Big Sister’s Illusion Magic, and my Finacée’s wit all working together, they manage to escape in no time.
Still, I won’t give up. I want them to understand just how powerful Second Mode really is.
“Damn it… no matter where I go, you always find me… This is too much of a hassle, I’m done.”
“But, Master—!”
“I’ll try to talk him into it somehow! Otherwise, we’ll be stuck like this forever.”
“I’m getting pretty tired of this, too…”
“Yeah, I’ve had enough.”
Big Sister and Finacée must be exhausted from this long-distance test run; they’ve climbed down from Filo-chan and are slumped over, completely drained. So this was all part of the training, was it!
“Welcome back, Father.”
With a screech, I brought the car to a stop, drifting slightly sideways as I pulled up next to Filo-chan and the others, and greeted him.
“So, what did you think? My Second Mode?”
“Drop dead. No, never mind… I get that it’s impressive. But Motoyasu, that… Second Mode, or whatever it’s called? I think you should save it for that one crucial moment—like a finishing move.”
“Is that so?”

“Ah, back when I was in Japan, I was an otaku who enjoyed all sorts of hobbies, so I think I understand that kind of romance. That’s exactly why you shouldn’t just use it all the time. It’s the contrast between slow and fast that… builds the excitement, don’t you think?”

That’s true. It’s always the same thing over and over… No matter how wonderful a date is, if you keep repeating the same thing, you’ll eventually get bored. So it’s important to throw in some surprises. As expected of Father—you really know how to speak your mind.
“Filo, you agree, don’t you?”
“Huh?”
“You do, right?”
“U-uh, yeah…”
Who would’ve thought even Filo-chan would agree? I guess that just goes to show he’s not Filo-chan’s Father for nothing. My respect for him just went up a notch.
“So, Second Mode… that’s enough, right?”
“Got it! Then I’ll start researching Third Mode.”
“So there’s still more to come… In a way, I’m actually getting curious to see just how far this will go.”
“Naofumi-sama!”
“Naofumi!?”
“W-well, for now, instead of something like Second Mode, we should just go for a more ‘motorcycle-like’ feel. Right?”

It seems Father is hoping for a more authentic motorcycle experience. Hmm… It’s true that over these past three days of riding in Second Mode, various issues have come up. All things considered, it just goes to show that modern motorcycles are designed with a lot of thought put into them.
“Filo, you might not like this, but… if you leave Motoyasu to his own devices for too long, this is what happens. You’ve got to compromise somewhere.”
“Nooo!”
“What if he starts chasing you while doing a somersault, claiming it’s ‘Tire Mode’ or something? Pay a little more attention to him.”
“Filo-chan, please. I really wish you’d cut me some slack.”
Even my Finacée is asking Filo-chan for something. A somersault, you say? I can’t see what’s ahead, but I’ll keep it in mind.
“I’ll do my best!”
“No, you don’t have to try so hard.”
“Yaaah! Ugh…”
“Just a little bit is fine… otherwise, the Spear Hero seems like he’ll keep transforming into something else.”
Filo-tan is looking at me. Yay! Motoyasu Brain is currently working on making the “R'yne Mode” operation—which Father requested—a reality.
“Ugh…! Filo, run!”
Oh! Filo-chan is saying she wants to run even more! I won’t be outdone either!
“…I wonder if that’s even human anymore… Heroes are monsters.”
“Well, that would mean I’d become one of them too…”

Father and the others were chatting with my Finacée while saying things like that. And just like that, our fun test run of Second Mode came to an end. By the way, ever since this incident, I’ve had the feeling that the relationship between Father and my Finacée has improved compared to before… but I suppose that’s just my imagination!
Before long… the day of the time limit from my previous loop arrived. Suddenly, a number appeared in my field of vision.
“So, in the end, it turned out just as Motoyasu said…”
“Either way, we can’t get started until we get through today.”
“That’s right. It’s not exactly for Ren or Itsuki’s sake, but just to see if we survivors can make it through, we’ve got no choice but to give it our all.”
Just as we were talking like that… a figure emerged from the crack in the waves.
“So this is the world we’re updating to?”
“Let’s get this started already.”
“I know.”

The Gathering behind us is trying to pry open the crack in the waves with their hands, as if to widen it. So they showed up after all. I’d thought they might not come out, but that was just wishful thinking.
“Not on my watch! Go, our mad dog!”
“Charge! Keel!”
“Huh!? You mean the guy with the spear, right?!”
Keel’s making some kind of joke, but following Father’s orders, I’m charging in too.
“‘“The new ability granted by the Goddess is seriously a cheat!”’”
“What do you mean, a cheat? Don’t mess with me! This is ‘New Game+’ for me!”

Father put his hand to his head and yelled. That’s right. “Just like back then, I’ll save the world alongside Father!” My heart was pounding with determination, but Father said with a complicated expression:
“Cheating versus New Game Plus… I wonder which one is actually stronger…”
“Naofumi-sama, pull yourself together!”
“This time, I won’t lose! Brionac X! Followed by Aiming Lancer X!”
I unleashed a preemptive strike on those guys. “Evaporate after taking my most powerful blow, fully enhanced!”
“Whoa, w-what!? Gaaaaaaaaah—”
That reincarnated guy I’ve seen before is holding his hands out. It looked like he was trying to block my Skills with a Wall, but he got blown to bits.
“Buhiiiiiiiiii!?”
Those pig-like reincarnated guys are making a racket, but I’m ignoring them. I’ll send you lot to the same place in a heartbeat.
“That attack seems pretty heavy. No, wait—it’s actually incredibly powerful. Well, as long as it doesn’t hit me, he’s no match for me—Whoa!”

He was spouting that kind of nonsense, but another reincarnator just vanished from my attack. With Defense Power so low that a single hit kills you if you can’t dodge, I figured it was only a matter of time before that happened. HAHAHA!
“……Isn’t he going to take care of them all by himself now?”
Watching the battle between me and the reincarnated folks, Father grumbled something to Big Sister.
“I understand how you feel, but they aren’t our only enemies…”
Big Sister is trying to cheer up Father.
“Damn it! What the hell is that guy? He’s cheating! I can’t take this anymore!”
Oh? An enemy has turned his back and is trying to run away. This is our chance! Their backs are wide open!
“Father!”
“Ah, yeah, yeah. Liberation Aura X.”

I heard that during this run, Older Sister became friends with a dragon she drinks with and received a blessing in exchange for a shard. Apparently, it’s a powerful Water-attribute dragon. It’s surprising just how well-connected she is.
Thanks to Father’s magic, I was instantly super-powered. Now that I’m like this, I’m invincible. I’m going to wipe Father and Filo-chan’s enemies off the face of the earth.
“Woooooooooo! I’m going to finish this in one gooooooo! Bryunak X! And Liberation Fire Prominence X!”
“H-hey, hurry up! Otherwise that cheat’s attack is coming!”
“Shut up! I’m in the middle of it right now!”

The fleeing reincarnated ones are huddled together in a tight cluster in front of the fissure. HAHAHA, I’ll wipe them all out in one fell swoop! The flash of Brionac and the heat of Fire Prominence are closing in on them.
“I-it’s coming! Gyaaaaaaaaaaaah!”
“Waaaaaaaaaaah!”
Some managed to escape the fissure and barely dodge my attack, but since I wasn’t aiming for them, I couldn’t care less. My main target is the Wave Fissure, after all.
“Haaaaaaaaa! Filo-taaaaaaaaaaan!”
I synchronized my mind with Filo-tan and slammed a Liberation Fire Prominence into the Wave Fissure, causing it to explode.
It wiped out even the ones at the far end of the fissure, and the fissure burst open in an instant. It felt like the same earthquake that happened when we fought before.
“Damn it! What the hell is this?! Do you guys hate updates that much?!”
“Don’t go causing trouble for everyone! You bunch of cheaters!”
“What a spectacular boomerang for all of you. Now, I’ll leave the disposal of the stragglers to you lot!”
With that order, Father’s subordinates all began capturing the reincarnated warriors. They’re incredibly well-organized. Just as you’d expect from Father’s men.
“……Does this mean Motoyasu is out of the picture, or will the wave continue?”
Like Father, I also checked the arrival time of the wave. Hmm…… Nothing’s happening.
There’s no next arrival time!
While helping with the cleanup, I waited until the time I remembered. But the hour hand of the True Dragon Clock showed no reaction at all.
“So, Motoyasu. Any changes?”
“Nope.”

“I get that the specs have changed in various ways… but since the arrival time for the next wave is gone too, does that mean the wave is over? It’s kind of anticlimactic—I don’t really feel like I’ve accomplished anything yet.”

Father was muttering to himself while checking the shield’s stats, but it seemed he couldn’t observe any further changes. I checked it myself, too, but couldn’t find any information that seemed relevant.
“We managed to overcome the wave, didn’t we?”
“Probably… though there might be another reason, like the mastermind having already been defeated.”
“Um… so, Naofumi-sama…”
“What is it?”
Big Sister asked Father, looking as if she were speaking with trepidation.
“Now that the world is at peace, does that mean… Naofumi-sama… will be going back to your original world…?”
Holding back tears, my Older Sister asked Father. At that, Father looked at her face, his gaze wavering as if he’d suddenly snapped back to reality. After pondering for a moment, Father said,

“It doesn’t seem like I’m going to be kicked out right away. It can’t hurt to put it on hold for a little while. For a while after I was summoned, I thought I’d be doomed, but it’s actually not so bad. There might still be something more to come.”
“That’s right!”
“Oh my? Naofumi-chan, you—”

Just as Older Sister was about to tease Father, something immense burst forth from behind Older Sister, overwhelming both Older Sister and everyone else present. This is it! If I say the wrong thing, I’ll be killed! Just as I’d expect from my Older Sister. I think I’ll just keep my mouth shut.
“Well, let’s just enjoy this world—which might actually be peaceful for a while.”
It seems Father has decided to stay in this world after all. At the very least, he’s saying he’ll take responsibility for my older sisters and the like.
“Oh my—”
“Well, things are going to get pretty busy from here on out. There’s also that human bike race tournament in Zeltoble that they’ve asked me to participate in.”
“It’s surprising that there are actually people who want to watch that—or even race in it.”
“Don’t say that… Motoyasu.”
“What is it?”
“So, come on out and enter the human bike race in Zeltoble. Since the lead rider will be Filo, ridden by Melty, that should really motivate you, right?”
What?! That would definitely motivate me. It’s a bit frustrating that my Finacée is riding Filo-tan, but I’m still happy about it.
“Huh!? My Lord!”
“If you participate seriously, I’ll give you a reward, so just bear with it.”
“Ugh…”

And just like that, our peaceful days began. It feels like the timeline and outcomes are different from the first world, but maybe this is for the best. For some reason, my Finacée this time has been relentlessly interfering with my trysts with Filo-chan, but the bigger the obstacle, the more fired up I get.

However… it’s a relief that not much has changed even without Ren and Itsuki. I was a bit concerned that Éclair was just acting as my Finacée’s bodyguard, and that I didn’t see that stalker pig around. I also have no idea where Rival’s foster parent has gone. The only one who’s truly pitiful is probably Kuro-chan, now that Ren isn’t around. Since there aren’t any creatures created by Father—based on my Older Sister—it’s quiet, I suppose.
And so, I’ve managed to rebuild a peaceful world once again.
I’m a bit hazy on exactly how many years have passed. The only thing I know for sure is… that world was saved.
Eventually… I felt as if a clock that looked familiar floated into my field of vision.
Selective Retrogression / Random Retrogression ←
Fifth Coordinate… Reference… Verification… Retrograde Start――
It happened suddenly. I heard an angry voice… that’s Éclair’s voice, isn’t it?
“You!”
My consciousness began to clear. It seems Éclair is in the middle of rushing toward the Smoked One, about to strike him with her sword.
“If we’re going to rewind time, please make sure we don’t make a mistake like this next time…”

Huh? Where am I? Before me stands my kind-looking Father. Looking around, I see a desolate landscape stretching out before me. It’s a place that feels vaguely familiar… but where is it, exactly? While I was pondering this, Éclair raised her sword toward Smoked.
“Guh! How dare you strike an ally with your sword! What do you think you’re doing?!”
“You have no honor! You fool who killed the Bow Hero just when the Wind started blowing against you!”

Éclair sliced through Smoked’s arm tendons with a follow-up strike and pinned him to the ground. I’m not entirely sure what’s going on, but good job, Éclair. Smoked just causes us nothing but trouble anyway.
……But wasn’t Smoked supposed to have been killed along with Itsuki? I heard from Father that the Stalker Pig testified to that…?
“Hurry up and tend to the Bow Hero’s wounds!　Don’t give up as long as there’s still a chance!”

Recovery healers rushed over to the wounded Itsuki all at once. It seems Itsuki is here too, not just Smoked. …He’s lying on the ground, but he’s holding a bow. I haven’t seen him once since the bow was taken by Takt… Hmm, it’s a mystery. Even before that, I can’t even understand why Itsuki—who was supposed to be dead—is even here.
“Motoyasu-kun?”
I couldn’t keep up with the situation and was trying to analyze it, but since Father called me, I’ll turn my attention to him. After all, I’m Father’s loyal subordinate.
“What is it?”
“You looked a bit spaced out—are you okay? Aren’t you about to loop again?”

Loop? Why on earth would you think I’d loop? Even if I’ve gained the ability to choose when to loop based on the name of a new skill, I won’t give up on this world. I’ve decided to fight alongside Filo-tan and Father until the very last moment.
……Motoyasu-kun?

No, that might not be what’s going on here. After all, Father is calling me “Motoyasu-kun.” Father I know well always just calls me “Motoyasu” without the honorific. But I do recall a time when Father called me “Motoyasu-kun.”
“Father, I’m a little confused myself, so could you please explain what’s happened since I was summoned?”
“Huh? Don’t we run out of time…”
“Please! This is very important.”
When I said that earnestly, Father agreed, though perplexed, to tell me the story.

“Um, on the first day after the summoning, Motoyasu-kun saved me and Ms. Eclair from Melromarc’s plot, and we managed to escape to Siltvelt—but then, because of Takt and his companions, who were pretending to be the Hero of the Claws, Siltvelt and Melromarc ended up having to go to war… I think.”
Hmm, I’ve got a general grasp of the situation. I deduced one possibility and said to Father,
“So after that, you won the battle, fought against Itsuki, and then that smoked guy—whose luck had turned sour—ended up getting killed by Itsuki, is that right?”
“That’s right… but the loop—”
I see. So that’s how it is.
…I remember it well. The feelings of Father, Lady Filolial, and our comrades—those we fought alongside. And the time we spent together, however brief it was.
“I was so happy to have been saved by Motoyasu-kun in this world. Thank you. It was a short time, but I really enjoyed it.”
I remember Father’s face as he said that, smiling sadly. I remember the promise I made with him—etched deep in my heart—that next time, we wouldn’t fail.
Yes… this world is—
“Father, the loop has already come around, you know.”
When I said that, Father tilted his head. That gentle reaction… no matter how I look at it, there’s only one answer.
“Huh? What do you mean by that?”
This world is… a world where, simply because I was immature, I caused Father sorrow.
“That’s right. This must be the world where I set off for Siltvelt with you, Father.”
I can remember that world as clearly as if it were yesterday. Father, Éclair, the people of Siltvelt… and Yuki-chan, Sakura-chan, and Kou. I’ve never forgotten any of them.

…It seems I’ve looped from the world where I remembered the future just as I was about to get kicked by Filo-tan into yet another world. I have absolutely no idea why this happened. Or rather, Rival and the Older Sister from the first world both said that the worlds I’ve been through so far don’t exist. Setting Rival aside, I can’t imagine the Older Sister from the first world would be wrong. There must be some reason for this.

But… either way, I have to save this world. No—precisely because I had no choice but to give up once before, I’ll prove that I can save it this time. I swear this, clenching the hand that holds my spear.
Filo-chan! Watch this! I’ll definitely bring peace to this world… I’ll show you true peace!
—And so, my new loop began. The continuation of a world that was supposed to have never existed has now begun.
The True Tutorial Arc is over. Starting next time, we’ll move on to the Siltvelt Arc: After.
